source_instruction: i'm trying to find high quality eyelash extensions that are 0.15 millimeters in diameter and 13-20 millimeters long.
query: Ugh, I swear my cat knocked over my houseplant again this morning and got potting soil all over the throw rug by the couch, and now I’m running late to meet my friend for boba after I finish browsing here. I also can’t stop thinking about how I forgot to pick up laundry detergent on my last grocery run, so I’ll have to make a detour on the way home, plus I need to remember to charge my wireless headphones before my commute tomorrow. Oh right, anyway, I’m looking for eye makeup that’s scratch-resistant, in the 0.15-d-mix-13-20mm option, and I don’t want to spend more than $20 on it.
